title: Africa Forward Summit Closes with 11-Point Green Industrialization Declaration
detail: The Africa Forward Summit concluded on May 12, 2026, in Nairobi with an 11-point joint declaration committing the Africa–France partnership to green industrialization, renewable energy expansion, and climate finance. The declaration covered geothermal, hydropower, wind, waste-to-energy, and nuclear power — all areas where Africa holds significant untapped potential. The summit affirmed commitments to regional energy market integration across East and West Africa, improved climate finance access for African countries, and accelerated deployment of distributed renewable energy. France pledged to prioritize just energy transition support for African partners through its climate finance facilities. The summit comes as sub-Saharan Africa's installed renewable capacity grew 15.9% in 2025 (per IRENA), though it still represents only 2% of global renewable additions, highlighting both the scale of the opportunity and the need for international finance mobilization.

title: Ford Energy Reveals DC Block BESS Product Specs: 512 Ah LFP Cells in Containerized 2- and 4-Hour Configurations
detail: A day after its subsidiary launch announcement, Ford Energy on May 12, 2026 published detailed specifications for its flagship DC Block battery energy storage product. The system is built around 512 Ah lithium iron phosphate (LFP) prismatic cells — the same chemistry dominant in Chinese utility storage and increasingly preferred globally for its thermal safety, longevity (6,000+ cycles), and cobalt-free supply chain. The DC Block comes in two configurations: FE-250 (2-hour, approximately 250 kWh per 20-ft container) and FE-450 (4-hour, approximately 450 kWh per container), designed for utility-scale deployment in standard container configurations. Production at Ford's Glendale, Kentucky plant begins ramp-up in 2026 with commercial deliveries targeted for late 2027. The US-manufactured BESS qualifies for Investment Tax Credit benefits under the Inflation Reduction Act's domestic content provisions. Ford Energy plans to target utility clients retiring coal plants and data center operators requiring behind-the-meter firm power.
